current_problem: One interface aggregates lifecycle resource factory command context diagnostics and capture.
action: Ratchet new aggregate dependencies; migrate callers to specific interfaces.

current_problem: Global aggregate renderer accessor remains public.
action: Restrict to startup/compatibility and remove from normal render paths.

current_problem: Command context still includes graph transient materialization methods.
action: Move graph materialization out of ordinary command context.

current_problem: Resource factory covers shaders meshes framebuffers textures dynamic VBs instancing.
action: Split only when callers can request narrower factory capabilities.

current_problem: Diagnostics are mixed into aggregate backend dependency.
action: Pass diagnostics snapshots/capability separately from draw command context.

current_problem: Raytracing capability is separate but still installed through global backend.
action: Pass raytracing explicitly to reflection pass.

current_problem: Concrete backend implements aggregate and raytracing plus many services.
action: Split by ownership family after interface callers migrate.

current_problem: Static backend instance is used by resource helper classes.
action: Pass backend/resource context into helpers instead of RenderBackendDX12::Get().

current_problem: Root signature/texture slot ABI is centralized in huge backend.
action: Keep stable but isolate from unrelated backend services.

current_problem: Lifecycle state resource creation graph capture diagnostics DXR timers dynamic VB debug lines and instancing share one class surface.
action: Move caller-facing access to narrow interfaces; leave DX12 internals private.

current_problem: Static singleton supports helper backdoors.
action: Replace helper backdoors in MeshDX12 FramebufferDX12 ShaderDX12 with explicit owner context.

current_problem: Graph-owned barriers are helper methods on backend not full pass ownership.
action: Move transition execution into graph executor for migrated passes.

current_problem: UAV barrier execution remains backend helper.
action: Own UAV ordering in graph executor for migrated resources.

current_problem: Transient graph resources materialize through aggregate command interface.
action: Move materialization to graph/DX12 transient owner.

current_problem: Default graph barrier policy documents intent while handwritten barriers may own execution.
action: Move migrated passes to execute/concrete policy and reject diagnostic-only for them.

current_problem: Default pass execution is declaration only.
action: Set callback/execute ownership for migrated pass rows.

current_problem: Callback path exists but must become production path pass by pass.
action: Use callback-owned execution for selected passes with typed user data.

current_problem: Pass desc defaults encourage diagnostic graph records.
action: Add validation that selected passes cannot stay DeclarationOnly.

current_problem: Framebuffer resource uses backend singleton.
action: Inject render backend/resource context into framebuffer creation/use.

current_problem: Mesh upload/render path uses backend singleton.
action: Pass command/resource context explicitly.

current_problem: Shader constant upload path uses backend singleton.
action: Pass binding/upload context explicitly.

current_problem: DXR init/dispatch lives on main backend class.
action: Split DXR resource/pipeline owner after reflection pass receives explicit capability.

current_problem: PSO creation and draw prep are backend class methods.
action: Move pipeline cache behind raster pipeline owner when graph pass execution is stable.

current_problem: Texture creation and mip generation live on main backend.
action: Split texture manager after texture service no longer depends on aggregate backend.

current_problem: Readback/capture is on main backend.
action: Keep capability separate from command/resource dependencies.

current_problem: Profiler owns GPU timing through backend class.
action: Split diagnostics capability from draw/resource interfaces.

current_problem: Device split exists but backend remains public facade for too much.
action: Push more DX12 ownership behind device/resource-specific owners.

current_problem: Graph transient stores raw native resource pointer.
action: Clarify ownership and move release through transient allocator.

current_problem: Executor exists for barriers but not full pass command recording.
action: Promote executor to own callbacks/resource state for selected passes.

current_problem: No ratchet prevents new aggregate IRenderBackend dependencies.
action: Add checks for new IRenderBackend and RenderBackendDX12::Get usage outside allowlist.
